To solve the problem, we need to determine the compounds formed when water reacts with chlorine.

When chlorine (Cl2) is dissolved in water, it reacts to form a mixture of hydrochloric acid (HCl) and hypochlorous acid (HClO):

\[ \text{Cl}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{HCl} + \text{HClO} \]

With this reaction, the correct answers should be HCl and HClO.
